body:
## Defect

Release image (milan-fpga's all-fabric placement), found by milan-fpga's two-placement simulation (kebag-logic/milan-fpga#665). Parent issue: kebag-logic/milan-fpga#858.

The ENTITY descriptor's `available_index` reads as the AEM image's constant 0, whatever ADP has sent.

IEEE 1722.1-2021 Table 7-2: the field is the same as the available_index field of ATDECC Discovery Protocol (6.2.2.15). The descriptor reports the value of the most recently sent ENTITY_AVAILABLE: 0 after the first, N-1 after N, and 0 again after ENTITY_DEPARTING.

## Acceptance

- READ_DESCRIPTOR(ENTITY) returns the last sent ENTITY_AVAILABLE's `available_index`.
- A test reads it after several advertisements and after ENTITY_DEPARTING; a planted mutant that serves the constant fails it.
- No change to the AEM image's other fields or to ADP's timing.
- The parent's gates that read AECP and ADP pass on a scratch parent with this head pinned.
title: ENTITY descriptor available_index is the AEM constant, not the last ENTITY_AVAILABLE's (1722.1-2021 Table 7-2)
